orderFlow.title: Order flow indicators: aggression, absorption and liquidity in WIN and WDO
orderFlow.intro: An order flow indicator helps reveal activity taking place behind a candle. This guide explains which data is observed, what it may indicate and the limits of this type of reading.

sections.title: What is an order flow indicator?
paragraphs: Order flow represents trades actually executed between buyers and sellers. Instead of looking only at the final price of a candle, order flow analysis examines how orders were taken, where trading concentrated and where the market encountered liquidity.

An order flow indicator organizes part of that data visually. It does not predict the future or replace the trader's decision, but it can make aggression, Times and Trades and price behavior easier to evaluate together.

sections.title: What to observe in the B3 Mini Index WIN and Mini Dollar WDO
paragraphs: The speed and volatility of WIN and WDO can make manual reading demanding. The goal is not to react to every color change, but to look for agreement between flow, price region and the context of each instrument.
items: Possible absorption when high volume produces limited price progress
Liquidity regions not yet tested during the session
Continuation, loss of strength or exhaustion near relevant levels

sections.title: Order flow versus price-based indicators
paragraphs: Moving averages, RSI and MACD mainly use previously recorded prices. They can help identify trend, acceleration or market conditions, but they do not directly show who aggressively bought or sold at that moment.
Order flow examines another information layer: execution. The approaches do not have to compete. Price structure can establish context while order flow helps qualify timing.

sections.title: How LGVG Flow organizes the reading
paragraphs: LGVG Flow supports the B3 Mini Index WIN and Mini Dollar WDO and uses flow data supplied by Profit. It displays visual signals and colored liquidity regions so traders can compare price behavior with executed pressure.
A signal is not an automatic order. Traders still need to check whether a region has already been mitigated, assess the day's context and define risk, stop and position size before entering.
items: Educational use supported by an installation and interpretation manual

sections.title: Compatibility, trial and limitations
paragraphs: Because it depends on actual flow data, LGVG Flow requires Profit Pro or Profit Ultra. Lower versions do not supply all the information needed for correct operation.
The 60-day trial lets traders observe the indicator in simulation and decide whether its reading fits their process. No indicator removes noise, slippage, changing volatility or financial risk.
items: Compatible platforms: Profit Pro and Profit Ultra
Supported instruments: B3 Mini Index WIN and Mini Dollar WDO

miniIndex.intro: Not every B3 Mini Index indicator analyzes the same information. Before installing a tool, understand its data source, the purpose of its signals and how it fits your trading plan.

sections.title: What a B3 Mini Index indicator should explain
paragraphs: WIN is a futures contract traded on B3 and often moves quickly during the session. A useful indicator should clearly explain what it calculates, which information it uses and under which conditions its signals should be interpreted.
Be cautious with tools presented as an automatic solution or a guarantee of accuracy. An indicator's value is in organizing relevant information consistently, not removing market uncertainty.

sections.title: Criteria for comparing day-trading indicators
paragraphs: The choice should reflect the trader's process, not only the chart's appearance. Indicators may measure trend, volatility, volume, aggression or price regions.
items: Source and freshness of the data
Availability of a manual, trial period and risk notice
Ability to validate the reading in simulation

sections.title: How order flow can complement the chart
paragraphs: A candle summarizes open, high, low and close for a period. Order flow adds information about how buyers and sellers executed trades inside that movement.

In WIN, aggression, absorption and liquidity can help distinguish a move backed by executed pressure from one with limited continuation. This remains contextual information, not absolute confirmation.

sections.title: How to test an indicator responsibly
paragraphs: Start in simulation, observe different trading hours and record what happened before and after each signal. Evaluate false moves and unclear conditions as carefully as successful examples.
LGVG Flow's free 60-day trial supports this evaluation without a credit card. The PSF installation file and manual cover configuration, liquidity regions and entry types.
items: Record time, context, entry, stop and outcome
Do not turn a small sample into a profit expectation

sections.title: The role of risk management
paragraphs: Even a coherent reading can end in a stop. Position size, daily loss limits and stop distance must be established before entry according to each person's profile and experience.
LGVG Flow is a visual support tool. It does not manage an account, prevent impulsive trades or replace knowledge of the instrument.

faq.question: What is the best indicator for the B3 Mini Index?
faq.answer: There is no universally best indicator. The choice depends on the data, the trader's method, clarity and responsible testing in simulation.

miniDollar.intro: The B3 Mini Dollar has its own dynamics and can react quickly to order flow and macroeconomic context. The current LGVG Flow version is prepared to organize this reading on WDO as well.

sections.title: What is the B3 Mini Dollar WDO?
paragraphs: WDO is the smaller-sized US dollar futures contract traded on B3. Traders use it to follow currency movements during the session, and it can experience rapid changes in volatility and liquidity.

Because it is different from the B3 Mini Index, WDO requires dedicated study of movement, financial value, trading hours and risk management. A numeric rule used on WIN should not be transferred automatically to the Mini Dollar.

sections.title: How order flow can help interpret WDO
paragraphs: Order flow reading observes executed trades, buying and selling aggression, potential absorption and regions where liquidity interest may be present.
In the Mini Dollar, this information can complement price structure and the context of the day. It does not predict the market with certainty and must be interpreted alongside predefined risk.
items: Liquidity lines that have not yet been mitigated
Visual signals placed in chart context

sections.title: Using LGVG Flow on the Mini Dollar
paragraphs: The current LGVG Flow version supports both the B3 Mini Index WIN and Mini Dollar WDO. Import the same LGVGFLOWATUAL.psf file into Profit and add it to the chart you want to study.
Because the indicator uses actual flow data, Profit Pro or Profit Ultra is required. LGVG Flow does not place orders or replace the trader's decision.

sections.title: How to test the indicator on WDO
paragraphs: After importing the file, open a Mini Dollar chart, add LGVG Flow and observe different periods of the session in simulation. Record the context, signal, liquidity region and subsequent price behavior.
The free 60-day trial lets you learn the reading without a credit card. Avoid drawing performance conclusions from only a few trades or one market condition.
items: Confirm that the open chart is WDO
Observe days with different volatility levels

sections.title: Risk management specific to the Mini Dollar
paragraphs: Stops, targets and contract quantity must consider WDO dynamics and financial value. The educational 250-point examples presented for the B3 Mini Index are not automatic parameters for the Mini Dollar.
Define risk before entry, respect a daily loss limit and stop trading when conditions are unclear. No indicator guarantees profitability.

faq.question: Does LGVG Flow work on the B3 Mini Dollar WDO?
faq.answer: Yes. The current version supports WDO and WIN when used on Profit Pro or Profit Ultra.

faq.question: Can I use the same 250-point WIN stop on WDO?
faq.answer: Not as an automatic rule. The Mini Dollar has its own dynamics and financial value, so stops and targets must be defined specifically for the instrument and trading plan.

faq.question: Does the indicator submit Mini Dollar orders?
faq.answer: No. LGVG Flow provides visual signals and context, but every decision and order remains the user's responsibility.

paragraphs: Creator of LGVG Flow, Gustavo Guimarães is an entrepreneur, Computer Scientist and specialist in developing technology solutions for companies and the financial market.
Founder of UAI Software and consultant to Grupo Cybersul, he has experience developing management software, web platforms, corporate dashboards and vehicle tracking systems.

He specializes in Telecommunications Engineering and Information Technology, has complementary studies in Law and a specialization in Web 3.0 (Blockchain, Smart Contracts and the Metaverse) from Brazil's Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI).
He is also the author of a technical work on GSM approved by the Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa (ISEL), in partnership with the University of Franca.

This experience in technology, systems analysis and software development was applied to the creation of LGVG Flow, an indicator designed to help traders read order flow, liquidity and operational context in B3 Mini Index and Mini Dollar trading.
